item.title: visualstudio: Visual Studio October Update – Compare Commits to Your Code, Resolve Conflicts in Bulk, Keep Coding
item.description:
Visual Studio October update adds commit-to-working-tree comparison, bulk merge conflict resolution, and several editor/UX refinements. It also refreshes Copilot chat, Hot Exit, keyboard tab controls, and Fonts and Colors.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: visualstudio: Compare today’s code with an earlier commit
item.description:
Visual Studio now lets you compare your current working tree with an earlier commit without checking out that commit or switching branches. The feature is described in a Visual Studio Blog post about comparing historical code against today’s code.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
item.description:
GitHub says that during periods of unusual traffic, some public repository clones and fetches over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication to protect github.com availability. The change is temporary and only affects some operations when the site is under load.

  • Source: GitHub
